title: Apple keyboard Function keys mode reaches the Apple driver

clauses.text: the Function keys mode choice is written to the Apple keyboard driver and the keys follow it

steps.do: On an Apple keyboard, choose the Function keys mode, then press the top row keys (F1 to F12) in a text field.
steps.expect: The keys behave as the choice says. If a choice of ISO layout or Option/Command swap was changed, unplug the keyboard and plug it in again, and check the keys once more.
